name: Wand of Fear
description: A wand of bone carved with screaming faces.
body:
## What it does

Spend a charge to give a single command, flee or grovel, or two to send terror through everyone in a 60-foot cone.

## Charges

It holds seven and regains 1d6 + 1 each dawn. Spend the last and it may crumble to ash.

features.name: Cone of Fear
features.text: 2 charges: each creature in a 60-foot cone makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is frightened of you for a minute, moving away from you on its turns.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles to ash
